behavior: Init reads chance and healing_debuff into +0x94/+0x98 and registers the ShareableActionPart wrapper in +0x6c (ActionsAfterDamageDealt).

Shared attack iterator at 0xeb9e7b gates after-damage callbacks on nonzero accumulated damage or nodamage/alleffect presence, and target participation (slot86). Runtime participation remains mapped to alive().
ShareableActionPart draws Random.value once, succeeds on sample <= chance/100, and constructs effect43 on trigger10 with the original skill duration and healing_debuff value.
InitializeBattleEffects at 0x4f099e..0x4f0a3f registers trigger10/effect43 using method usage GOT+0x4b030, resolved to metadata41071.
Effect43 handler0x51a7ff returns ((100-value[0])*runningHeal)/100 without intermediate integer conversion. EvaluateEffect is a visual callback.

ApplyEffectsOnTriggerType sorts effect groups and their operations by BattleEffectType and feeds each float result into the next. HealCurrentTurn normalizes the complete trigger10 pass before HP application.
limitations: Only the ordinary healing-reduction attack template is added; healing-increase/passive/environmental skills, consumable bypass and full trigger/perk ordering are pending.
Unity RNG parity, full native participation and source/dictionary lifetime semantics remain incomplete.
The existing effect owner retains insertion order among same-type curses. Native dictionary enumeration order is not established; floating-point edge cases may differ.
HP and base attack remain integer; full-game and cross-platform parity are not claimed.
